caveats: Second civil suit against ex-officer Sean Pena: Lisa Gutierrez filed June 18, 2021 in U.S. District Court of Arizona over an Aug 5, 2019 assault. KRDO (Nov 17, 2021) reports a $425,000 Phoenix council settlement vote for an 'unnamed woman' assaulted by Pena — plaintiff not named, but the Lee settlement was already approved June 2021, so this is presumed to be Gutierrez; azfamily (Aug 2022) confirms both Lee and Gutierrez settled with the city (amounts not given there). Pena acquitted across two criminal trials (May and Aug 2022).
